name: 口袋观察站
phase: visual and interaction refinement, not yet implemented

components.body_text: Readable Chinese; pixel styling primarily in icons, numerals and stepped corners
components.rule: Same silhouette and icon position across button states

interaction_rules: Default feeding popover closed; open only after selecting feeding tool
Species label shown on hover/selection; collapse after observation to restore the view
Only one contextual panel open at a time
Discovered entries are recorded automatically; manual inspection never gates collection
Unknown entries use silhouettes and clues, with favorite/replay unavailable
Guide contains five categories; category counts sum to unique collection count
Focus hides ordinary HUD and retains discoveries in a quiet queue
UI styling must never modify runtime scenery layers or atmospheric animation
proposed_additions: Three seed stocks and quantity-based replenishment
scope_note: These are approved-direction design images; generated scenery contains slight redraws. Original game scenery assets are not edited.
